'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de stong nyid sngar ma rtogs gsar rtogs min par thal/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ grub mtha' dang 'gal/ 'di skye 'phags gang yin dpyad pa la/ kha cig na re/ 'phags pa yin te/ 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir/ zer na/ 'o na/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen tshogs lam pa chos can/ dgra bcom yin par thal/ dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi slob pa yin par thal/ dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la mi slob lam yod par thal/ khyod dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de med par thal/ khyod kyis theg dman gyi mi slob lam ni btang*/ theg chen gyi mi slob lam ni ma thob/ khyod kyi mi slob lam de/ mi slob lam phung po gsum pa ni min pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de 'dra'i mi slob lam de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i slob lam de/ slob lam phung gsum pa yin par thal/ khyod mi slob lam phung gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de'i rgyud kyi so sor rtag 'gog de/ rtag 'gog phung gsum pa yin par thal/ de'i mi slob lam de phung gsum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ khyod kyi bral/ rgyur gyur ba'i bar chad med lam de/ bar chad med lam phung gsum pa yin par thal/ khyod rtag 'gog phung gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na min par thal/ khyod kyi bral rgyur gyur ba'i bar chad med lam yin na/ theg dman gyi bar chad med lam yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa phung gsum pa 'dod pa la'ang rgya cher sbyor/ gzhan yang*/ nyan thos bsgom lam par thal/ nyan thos bsgom lam pa'i spangs rtogs thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de'i 'dra'i spangs rtogs las ma nyams par yin par thal/

'phags pa'i spangs rtogs las ldog pa mi srid pa gang zhig khyod kyi de thob pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ 'di theg chen 'phags pa yin par thal/ theg chen skyes bu dang*/ 'phags pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa yin te/ 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs la ma nyams pa'i phyir/ 'o na de chos can/ khyod theg chen dgra bcom yin par thal/ khyod theg chen dang*/ dgra bcom gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gsum char khas blangs/ dgra bcom pa yin par thal/ de'i spangs rtogs thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir/ gsum char ro// gzhan yang*/ chos can theg chen gyi mthong lam thob myong bar thal/ theg chen 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ theg chen 'phags pa yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam thob myong bas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags 'bud/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni zhes par/ rnam bshad pa/ byang sems 'phags chos can/ srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi spong ste/ 'khor ba ji srid par sems can gyi don byed par bzhugs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ der thal/ sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba'i phyir te/ rtogs yes chos sku don du gnyer ba'i theg chen sems bskyed rgyud la ldan pa'i phyir/ yang*/ rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de spong bar thal/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi bar chad med lam de de spong ba'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ de der thal/ de spong ba'i bar chad med lam yod/ de yod na de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma 'bud/ snga ma der thal/ de shes bya'i sgrib pas zin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa de/ 'dir bstan nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba len par thal/

sbyor ba de la khyab 'brel yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye ba par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ khyab par thal/ 'dir bstan nyon mongs yin na/ nyon mongs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ der thal/ 'di bstan nyon mongs pa gcig yod pa'i phyir/ rtags song*/ dar ṭīka pa/ 'dir bstan nyon mongs pa de/ nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin/ de yang skye ba len pa'i rgyur dgos pa ni min te/ byang sems 'phags pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i grogs su nges par dgos pas mi spong ba yin zhes zer na/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs ma spangs pa de rgyu lam shes kyi rang bzhin min par thal/ rgyu lam shes yin na/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs ma spangs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dar ṭīka pa nyid dang 'gal/ ma grub na/ re zhig khas blangs shing*/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen mthong lam pa chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum min/ ci ste 'dod na/ der thal/ khyod kyi nyon mongs ma lus pa spangs pa gang zhig 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs kyi rang bzhin de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum char ro// gzhan yang*/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs de byang sems 'phags pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i grogs su nges par dgos pa min par thal/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs rgyud la mi ldan pa'i byang sems gzhan don sgrub nus yod pa'i phyir/ rtags song zhing*/ ma grub na/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ 'di rang bzhin gyi nyon mongs rgyud la ldan dgos par thal/ rtags ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ gsum char grub mtha' la khas blangs/ gzhan yang*/ dman lam mngon du ma song ba'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi 'dir rang bzhin nyon mongs chos can/ dman lam mngon du ma song ba'i byang sems kyi rgyud la khyod spong byed kyi bar chad med lam med par thal/

des khyod ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs 'dod na/ chos can/ de'i rgyud la de yod par thal/ khyod de'i nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul ma yin/ zhes par/ rnam bshad pa/ lam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin zer/ tshig ltar na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ rnam mkhyen yin par thal/ rnam pa bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'khrul shes yin par thal/ 'khrul pa bden med du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ don ltar na/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ lam shes yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar chos can/ rtog med kyi shes pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang yul don spyi'i tshul gyis yul du byed pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ de bden med du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de nyan thos gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin no zer na/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam mtshan nyid pa yin par thal/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab par thal/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin na/ nyan thos kyi lam mtshan nyid pa shes pa'i lam shes yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de chos can/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs pa yin par thal/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs par thal/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na 'gal/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos kyi bdag med rtog pa'i rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma la khyab pa med na/ shes bya chos can/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs pa yin na/ de'i rtogs rigs yin dgos par thal/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag yin na/ de'i rtogs rigs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags 'bud/ dar ṭīka pa/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam de/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin zhes gsung ngo*// 'o na/ shes bya chos can/ de yin na/ de yin dgos par thal/ de'i mtshan gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems kyi mthong lam chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir te/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa dang*/ theg chen mthong lam gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su ched du shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa grub la khas blangs/ 'dod na chos can/ byang sems kyi shes mthong gi ltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas par thal lo// chos can/ byang sems 'phags pa mngon du bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas par thal/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'gal/ khyab pa grub mtha' la khas blangs/ ma grub na/ khas blangs shing*/ der thal/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ mthong lam gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang shes bya chos can/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i sbyor lam de/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam la bya rigs par thal/

'di rang bzhin gyi nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i mthong lam de/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi mthong lam gyi byed rigs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ de'i skabs su theg chen gyi sbyor lam de/ stong nyid kyi rnam pa can du dngos su bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ grub mtha' dang yang 'gal lo// gzhan yang*/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i rgyu lam shes yin na/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i rgyu lam shes min dgos par thal ba dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyu lam shes yin na/ nyan thos kyi de min dgos par thal/ snga ma de yin na/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug rnam pa can gyi rgyu lam shes yin dgos/ phyi ma de yin na/ chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa can gyi rgyu lam shes yin dgos/ de gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ rtags gnyis ka grub mtha' la khas blangs/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ rigs can gsum gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rigs can gsum gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan du tshang ba'i theg chen gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ rigs can gsum gyi lam shes pa'i rgyu lam shes ma grub par thal/ rtsa bar 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i lam shes gcig ma grub par thal/ rigs can gsum ka'i rtogs rigs rdzogs par bsgom pa'i rgyu lam shes ma grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// zhes par/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa las lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par 'phags te/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe slob dpon gzhan la mi ltos par rang byang chub mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ zer na/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba de gzhung de'i don sbyor ma yin par thal/ gzhung de rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa'i lam bgrod tshul ston byed yin pa'i phyir/

der thal/ de 'dra des srid pa tha ma'i tshe/ rang rgyal gyi dgra bcom sngon du byed tshul ston pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ spang bya gcig char ba'i rgyun zhugs kyi thob pa'i rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ chos can/ min par thal/ khyod kyi lam bgrod tshul dang gcig char ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i lam bgrod tshul la khyad par ci yang med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyis rang gi gdul bya la sgra med du chos ston/ zer na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rang gi gdul bya la sgra med du gdams ngag ston par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi gdul bya la sgra med du ngag ston par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ ngag yin na sgra yin dgos pa'i phyir/ yang bse ru lta bu chos can/ khyod rang gi gdul bya dang lhan cig gnas par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bse ru lta bur gcig pur gnas pa min par thal lo// yang chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi gdul bya la sgra med du chos bstan pas/ khyod kyis gdul byas chos thos pa gcig yod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir 'dod na/ sgra med rtag shes la gnang ba gcig yod par thal lo// gzung don rtog pa spong ba'i phyir/ zhes par/ rang rgyal gyi lam chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan pa yin te/ gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par/ 'dzin rtog spong ba'i khyad par/ rten rigs kyi khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir zer na/ dar ṭīka pa'i phyogs la/ shes bya chos can/ de de 'dra'i khyad par gsum ldan min par thal/ rang rgyal mthong lam des rang lam du 'dzin rtog spong ba'i phyir/ khas blangs shing*/ der thal/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtog pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam gzhi grub pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ 'di rang gzhan gyi khyad par gsum ldan du thal/ gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par sogs gsum ldan yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ khyod kyis shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ba'i phyir/ der thal/ shes sgrib gzung rtog ma spangs pa'i sems can yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ des shes sgrib 'dzin rtog spong na/ rang rgyal gyi lam des shes sgrib 'dzin rtog mi spong ba bud do// rtags gsum pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ 'di rang gzhan rten rigs kyi khyad par dang ldan par thal/ gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig rang rgyal gyi lam de gzung rtog spangs pa'i khyad par/ 'dzin rtog ma spangs pa'i khyad par/ rten rigs kyi khyad par gsum dang ldan zer na/ rang rgyal gyi lam de khyad par gsum ldan min par thal/ rang rgyal gyi mthong lam des gzung rtog ma spangs pa'i phyir te/ de'i sa bon spong ba'i bar chad med lam sngon du ma song ba'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ nyan thos las khyad par 'phags te/ gzung rtog spangs pa'i phyir/ theg chen las dman te/ shes sgrib 'dzin rtog ma spangs pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o na/ de chos can/ shes sgrib gzung rtog sa bon dang bcas pa ma lus pa spangs par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi bar chad med lam rdzogs par thob par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba thob par thal lo// byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ theg chen las dman par thal/ shes sgrib 'dzin rtog ma spangs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes sgrib spangs par thal lo// skabs 'dir/ dar ṭīka pas/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas bden med rtogs so zhe na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshan nyid pa yod par thal/

dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la bden med rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam skyes par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi phyogs gcig spangs pa'i rnam grol lam yod par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig khyod mi slob pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rang rgyal mthong lam yod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rtogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam bzod pa brgyad yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rtogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam yod par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ shes sgrib 'dzin rtogs kyi sa bon spong ba'i rang rgyal gyi bar chad med lam yod par thal lo// 'dir gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i don dris pa la/ phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pa la byed do zhe na/ 'o na skabs 'dir phyi rol gyi don yod dam med/ yod na rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ bden med rtogs par thal/ tshad mas grub pa'i chos gcig bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir med na/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod kyis phyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan thos las khyad par du 'phags pa min par thal/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas kyang phyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ bsal pa khas blangs/ ma grub na/ phyi don chos can/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas khyod med par rtog par thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir/ yang kho na re/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa de/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i don yin no zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du 'dzin pa'i blo de shes sgrib gzung rtogs yin par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po dang sngon 'dzin gyi mngon sum rdzas gzhan ma yin par thal/

'dod na/ sngon po med par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ lhan cig dmigs nges de sngon po dang sngor snang dbang rdzas can min par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag min par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas can yod par thal lo// skabs 'dir rang rgyal dgra bcom pas shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs so zhe na de chos can/ gzhi dang de'i gnyen po yi/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i gzung rtog spangs par thal/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtog par thal lo// yang kha cig des de ma spangs so zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ des de spangs par thal/ de dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs gcig po gzung ba'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa dag spangs pa dang zhes pa'i gzhung rtsa 'grel de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam gzhag ston byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhi dang zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog de/ 'di rang gzhan gyi shes sgrib 'dzin rtog yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i skabs nas bstan pa'i gzung rtog de'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtog pa'i bar chad med lam de/ 'di rang gzhan gyi 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtog pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ bden med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir dar ṭīka pa na re/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par bshad pa de/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i drang don yin gsung ngo*// khas blangs 'gal ste/ shes bya chos can/ chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa'i rang rgyal gcig med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ rtags la khas blangs/ yang 'dzin pa ma spong phyir dang ni zhes pa'i rgyan gzhung chos can/ khyod nges don du 'jog pa'i skabs med par thal/ khyod brjod byed kyi sgo nas kyang drang don gyi gzhung yin/ brjod bya'i sgo nas kyang drang don gyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/

khyab pa khas blangs te/ theg chen gyi lugs la/ drang nges 'jog tshul gnyis so sor nges par khyed 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po khas blangs shing*/ der thal/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i drang don yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa khas blangs shing*/ der thal/ kun rdzob bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung tshig yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'di chos can/ khyod nges don gyi mdo'i dgongs pa drang don gyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i gzhung yin par thal/ khyod kyi bshad bya'i sher phyin gyi mdo de/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i nges don gyi mdo gang zhig khyod sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa'i dgongs pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ gzhung 'di chos can/ khyod dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyi gzhung ma yin par thal/ dbu ma pa rang lugs la khyod kyi bstan bya'i don de khas blangs du mi rung ba'i phyir/ rnam bshad kyi rjes 'brang la la ni/ rang rgyal la slob pa med do zer ro// shes bya chos can/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spong bar byed pa'i rang rgyal gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rang rgyal rnams kyang bsdus pas/ de'i phyir de dag gi shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du sgom pa'i lam zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa gnyis yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal/ kha cig rang rgyal la 'bras bu bzhi'i rnam gzhag med par 'dod pa ni/ sa sde las/ rang rgyal gyi lam bgrod tshul gsum gsungs pa dang 'gal te/ lam bgrod tshul gsum pa'i skabs su/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can la la ni/ bskal chen rgyar tshogs bsags/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu tsam mngon du byas/ skye ba phyi ma la 'bras bu phyi ma gnyis mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ phung po sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par slob par gsungs pa'i phyir/

'dir rnam bshad kyi rjes 'brang bdag rang rgyal gyi chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par 'dod/ 'o na/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med des chos kyi bdag med kyi go mi chod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas can du zhen pa'i shes sgrib gzung rtog des shes sgrib kyi go mi chod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ don gsal las/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs gcig po gzung ba'i don gyi rnam par rtog pa zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de dag gis shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo// kho na re rang rgyal dgra bcom pas bden med rtogs par thal/ des chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'dod do// 'o na/ 'dzin pa bden med du rtogs par thal lo// zhe na/ khyab pa med de/ de chos can/ shes sgrib 'dzin rtog spong ba'i bar chad med lam dang ldan par thal/ ngos skal gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ba'i bar chad med lam dang ldan pa'i phyir/ yang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ gzung 'dzin dbang shes bden med du rtogs par thal/ gzugs bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ bden pa'i gcig dang du bral gyi rtags la brten nas gzugs bden med du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis chos can/ 'dzin pa bden med du rtogs par thal/ bden med rtogs pa'i phyir te/ gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod mchog gang rung yin par thal/ 'dzin pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ gzung med rtogs pa rnal 'byor gyi sa de chos can/ 'dzin pa bden med du rtogs par thal/ gzung ba bden du rtogs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ 'dzin med rtogs pa rnal 'byor gyi sa des/ phyi rol don la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/

der thal/ de yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma bzhin du ngo bo nyid med de/ zhes pa'i gzhung gis yang sgra des de bden med du rtogs par bstan pa'i phyir/ yang dar ṭīka pa gzhung 'di zab mo stong pa nyid kyi snod du gyur pa'i gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rang rgyal la chos kyi bdag med rtog pa med par bstan pa yin no zer/ 'o na/ shes bya chos can/ gzhung 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can yod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhung 'di chos can/ khyod theg pa thun mong gi gzhung yin par thal/ khyod gzhung gang zhig 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di theg pa thun mong gi bstan bcos yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni grub pa'i mtha' la khas blangs pa dang 'gal ba kho na yin no// bden dang bden la bzod pa dang zhes par/ sbyor ba dang*/ theg chen mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag dris pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ skabs dang por bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu'i ldog cha nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ skabs dang por rnam mkhyen de rgyus mtshon pa'i tshul gyis bstan par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ skabs dang por bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ rgyu lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos su thal/ skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skabs dang po de skabs gnyis pa yin par thal lo// mtshan nyid la/ chos nyid sngar ma mthong gsar du mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/

de theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod kyi dngos kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod des chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/ yang chos nyid sngar ma rtogs gsar du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs zer na/ snga ma de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod kyi dngos kyi nyer len du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sdug bsngal la chos bzod des chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ yang theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ ce na/ shes bya chos can/ bden pa mngon rtogs yin na/ mthong lam yin pas khyab par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs la/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de der thal/ mdzod las/ de ltar bden pa mngon rtogs 'di/ sems bcu drug go /zhes gsungs/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ de min par thal/ de la skad cig bco lnga ni/ ma mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ mthong lam yin par thal/ bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de mngon par rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir/ dar ṭīka pa bzod pa brgyad ka bar chad med lam dang*/ shes pa brgyad kyi rnam grol lam yin zer/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes bzod de/ rang gi ngos skal gyi sdug bsngal mthong spangs spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam yin par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis sa bon drungs 'byin mi nus pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spangs kyi sa bon gcig yod par thal/

'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ rjes bzod gnyis kyis khams gong 'og gi bden pa la so sor dmigs par thal/ mthong lam bzod pa brgyad ka bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ ma khyab te/ theg chen mthong lam bzod pa brgyad po yin khyab mnyam dang*/ shes pa brgyad po de yin khyab mnyam yin no// zhe na/ 'o na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam rjes bzod chos can/ mthong lam skad cig bcu drug gi dang po yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong sdug bsngal chos bzod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ skad cig bco lnga pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po de chos can/ bcu lnga pa yin par thal/ lam la rjes bzod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ dang po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam skad cig bcu drug gi rnam gzhag mi 'thad par thal lo// yang theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes de chos can/ mthong spangs ma lus par spangs pa'i rnam grol yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bcu drug pa lam la rjes shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sdug bsngal chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi ming can yin par thal/ mthong spangs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gsum char khas blangs so// bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kyi rtogs pa la gnas pa'i byang sems de chos can/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i ming can byang sems yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang po bco lnga gang rung gi rtogs pa la gnas pa'i byang sems gang zhig phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa min pa'i phyir/ rtags snga ma khas blangs/ phyi ma der thal/ de la gnas bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i phyir/ gsum char/ byang sems la zhugs gnas brgyad kyi rnam gzhag mtshan nyid pa byed pa'i skabs su khas blangs so// gzhan yang*/

nyan thos kyi mthong lam bzod pa brgyad po de ngo bo gcig tu skye zhing*/ shes pa brgyad po de ngo bo gcig tu skye bar thal/ byang sems kyi mthong lam de de ltar du skye ba gang zhig de la gnyis dngos po'i gnas tshul la skye tshul 'dra ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dod nyon dgu pa tsam mthong lam gyi snga rol du spangs shing*/ sdug bsngal chos shes kyi rtogs pa la gnas pa'i nyan thos de chos can/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas yin par thal/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs shing bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa la gnas pa'i 'bras gnas yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa mngon du song ba'i gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod de chos can/ bar chad med lam yin par thal/ sdug bsngal chos bzod yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ chos can ma grub pas/ rtags ma grub bo zhe na/ de 'o na sngon song gi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam med par thal/ de 'dra'i byang sems kyi mthong lam bzod pa yang med/ shes pa yang med pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i shes pa med par thal/ de 'dra'i bzod pa med pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de 'dra'i byang sems kyi mthong lam yang yin/ nyon sgrib spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun gcig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ 'o na/ de 'dra chos can/ rnam grol lam yin par thal/ gang rung gang zhig bar chad med lam min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig de yin na de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ theg chen gyi bar chad med lam gyi rtogs pa sngon du ma song ba'i phyir/ zhe na/ gang rung ma grub ste/ khyad par gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i khyad par gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa'i phyogs la/

chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod chos can/ bar chad med lam yin par thal/ chos bzod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi bar chad med lam yod par thal lo// yang skabs 'dir/ bzod pa brgyad ka bar chad med lam du khas len mi rigs par thal/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ chos bzod bzhi po kho na bar chad med lam du gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bar chad med lam gyi rnam pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang mi ldan pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa bzhi'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las theg chen mthong lam shes bzod bcu drug pos rtag mi rtag la sogs pa'i sgro 'dogs bcu drug rim bzhin sel bar byed cing*/ nges shes bcu drug rim bzhin 'dren par byed do// zhes gsungs/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes de chos can/ bar chad med lam yin par thal/ rang gi bsal bya sgro 'dogs kyi sa bon la gnod byed kyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod des/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i chos nyid ma lus pa mngon sum du ma rtogs par thal/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga sdug bsngal yin min gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i spros bral sogs lhag ma gsum po mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ sdug bsngal mthong spangs kyi sa bon ma lus pa drungs 'byin pa'i bar chad med lam ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ yang*/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes de chos can/ sdug bsngal mthong spangs ma lus pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam min par thal/ sdug bden la bdag yod med dang*/ stong mi stong gi spros bral de mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du lam la rjes shes chos can/ mthong spangs ma lus pa spangs pa rnam grol lam ma yin par thal/

lam bden gyi chos nyid ma lus pa ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lam bden de nges 'byin yin min gyi spros bral mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa'i phyogs la/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod de chos can/ bar chad med lam yin par thal/ chos bzod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi bar chad med lam yod par thal lo// 'dir dar ṭīka pa/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems mthong lam gnyis ka 'gal bar bzhed do// 'o na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod gnyis gcig char du skye'am/ rim gyi skye/ dang po ltar na/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la bden gnyis gcig char du 'jal ba'i tshad ma yod par thal/ stong nyid dang gang zag gi bdag med gcig char du 'jal ba'i tshad ma yod pa'i phyir/ gsum char khas blangs/ 'dod na/ slob lam na bden gnyis ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum char grub mtha' la khas blangs so// gnyis pa ltar na/ de gnyis sngon la gang skye/ gang ltar na'ang*/ shes bya chos can/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs ma myong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gcig yod par thal/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de sngar skye ba'i phyir/ yang*/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs ma myong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gcig yod par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de sngar skye ba'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ khyed ltar na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la bden gnyis gcig char du 'dzin pa'i blo gnyis gcig char du yod par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de nyams su myong ba'i rag rig mngon sum gnyis gcig char du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi rgyud la mnyam rjes gnyis gcig char du yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs so// yang dar ṭīka pa/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam de/ byang sems 'phags pas shes mthong gis ltas nas 'da' bar bya ba zhes zer/ khas blangs nang 'gal te/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam gcig med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khas blangs shing*/ de yod par thal/ nyon sgrib lhan skyes kyi sa bon spong bar byed pa'i gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam gcig yod pa'i phyir te/ dman lam mngon du ma song ba'i nyon sgrib ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ rtags grub mthar khas blangs so// 'dir mthong lam la mnyam gzhag gi khyab ma khyab dris pas/ khyab bo zhe na/ theg chen mthong lam rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa med par thal/ de la des khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam pa dbang 'bring gzhan ngor gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag gcig med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming gi brtags nas bstan pa'i mthong lam rjes thob med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'grel pa las/ de ltar min na rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la so so rang gis rig pa'i skad cig ma rnams gzhan ji ltar yid ches par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal/

yang de nyid gsal bar brjod na/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni// byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i// mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// zhes pa'i bzod shes skad cig bcu drug po de mnyam gzhag kho na yin par thal/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bcu drug po de chos can/ byang sems mthong lam pa dbang 'bring gzhan ngor rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag min par thal/ mnyam gzhag kho na yin pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad pa'i 'khor gsum khas blangs so// gnyis pa ltar na/ shes bya chos can/ de yin na mnyam gzhag yin nas khyab par thal/ shes bzod skad cig bcu drug po de mnyam gzhag kho na yin pa gang zhig bcu drug po bar ma chad du skye ba yin zhing*/ mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig bcu drug tu grangs nges pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rjes thob gcig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra de chos can/ khyod mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ chos shes gnyis kyi bar der skye bar thal/ khyod yod pa gang zhig khyod yod na/ khyod der skye dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod yin par thal/ khyod theg chen gyi mthong lam la rjes shes kyi rtogs pa rdzogs rjes kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs so// rtsa bar 'dod na/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes de chos can/ sdug bsngal mthong spangs kyi sa bon las dngos su grol ba'i rnam grol lam min par thal/ khyod dang rang rgyu de spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam gnyis kyi bar du rjes thob ye shes kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam rnam grol lam yin na/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam las dngos su ma byung dgos par thal/

shes bzod bcu drug gi bar du de'i ming can gyi rjes thob re res chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ theg chen gyi mthong lam la mnyam gzhag gis ma khyab par thal/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs kyi skabs su rjes thob ye shes bshad pa'i phyir/ zer ro// la la na re/ de la des ma khyab par thal/ skad cig brgyad par tshad med bzhi bsgom par bshad pa'i phyir/ zer ro// dang po mi 'thad par ston pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa dang po'i ye shes yin na/ mthong lam yin pas khyab par thal/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs du rjes thob bshad na/ mthong lam rjes thob yod dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ 'grel chen las/ sa dang po'i skad cig gnyis pa yan chad sgom lam yin par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mi 'thad pa ni/ mnyam gzhag tu/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa mi srid par thal/ khyab 'brel de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod mnyam gzhag sgom pa srid par thal/ khyod bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir dar ṭīka pa/ kun rdzob dngos yul du byed pa'i slob pa'i mkhyen pa la/ rjes thob ye shes kyi khyab par 'dod la/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes dang rjes thob ye shes gnyis gcig tu skye bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rtags khas blangs par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med skabs 'dir kun rdzob bden par khyed kyis 'dod pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa/ stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud la theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed mngon gyur pa med par bzhed pa mi 'thad de/

'o na/ shes bya chos can/ shes rab kyi phar phyin dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi mthong lam yin na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pas khyab par 'dod/ de lta na/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs pa ye shes chos kyi sku la dmigs pa'i theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang yul sher phyin la lkog gyur du dmigs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar ma grub na/ khyod theg chen gyi lam yin pa gang zhig khyod theg chen gyi lam yin na/ de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod thabs shes zung du 'brel pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis zin pa'i theg chen sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ 'o na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de yang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed kyis ma zin par 'dod dgos pas/ de chos can/ theg chen gyi lam min par thal/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang der thal/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi ma zin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs so// yang skabs 'dir/ rnam bshad pa/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kyi dngos 'bras su gyur pa'i rjes thob ye shes de sgom lam du 'dod do// de lta na/ de chos can/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin par thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgom lam bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam ma skyes gong gi rjes thob yin pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ de chos can/ sgom lam rjes thob tu thal/ gang rung gang zhig mthong lam rjes thob min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgom lam mnyam gzhag gi rtogs pa mngon du song bar thal/ sgom lam rjes thob yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ bcu drug pa'i dngos 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan dag na re/ de dag gis ni sgom lam pa'i rim pa ma bstan pa'i phyir mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan no// zhes par/ de bzhin nyid kyi zhes sogs kyi gzhung chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ mnyam gzhag tu sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ rjes thob tu yid la byed pa'i rim pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas blangs so// zhe na/ 'o na/ de 'dra'i gzhung chos can/ rjes thob gcig bstan par thal/ rjes thob tu yid la bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa'i phyir te/ mthong lam rjes thob bstan pa gang zhig de bstan na de bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ shes bzod bcu drug po kho na bstan pa gang zhig de yin na mnyam gzhag yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ skabs dang po gsum du chos can/ mnyam gzhag tu sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ rjes thob tu yid la byed pa'i rim pa ma bstan par thal/ bsgom bya'i rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar ma grub na/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bstan par thal/ de bstan pa gang zhig de bstan na/ de bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i shes rnam bstan par thal/ de bstan pa gang zhig de bstan na de bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs su mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bstan tshul dang*/ skabs dang po gsum du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bstan tshul la khyad par med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// zhes sogs la/ 'dir bstan gyi kun nas zhi ba sogs drug chos can/

theg chen bsgom lam gyi byed pa yin te/ zer na/ de chos can/ khyod de min par thal/ theg chen bsgom lam gyi snga rol na khyod yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ theg chen bsgom lam gyi byed pa ma yin par gyur pa'i khyod yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi bsgom lam sgom stobs kyi thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin zer na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi bsgom lam yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi rgyu med par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu yod par thal/ khyod 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ khyab pa med de/ bral 'bras so sor rtag 'gog chos can/ der lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ med par thal/ 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ 'dus byas bral byas 'bras bu yin// 'dus ma byas la de dag med// ces mdzod las gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam bsgoms par las byung ba'i dge legs de/ theg chen bsgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ min par thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam las byung ba min pa'i phyir te/ de'i skyed 'bras min pa'i phyir te/ de'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i rtags ma grub na/ der thal/ theg chen gyi sgom lam rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ byed pa'i 'og tu sgom pa'i lam ste/ zhes par theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ gnyis yod de/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i sgom lam dang zag pa med pa'i sgom lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ theg chen gyi sgom lam yin na/ zag med yin pas ma khyab par thal/ de la zag bcas zag med gnyis su dbyer yod pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ des khyab par thal/ de yin na nyon mongs med pa'i sgom lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad pa'i phyogs la'o// dar ṭīka pa'i phyogs la des khyab par thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin na/ zag bcas zag pa med chos dang*// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i zag med yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de yin na rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya bdag tu lta ba'i gnyer sor gyur pa'i sgom lam yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dir sgom lam mnyam gzhag la zag med dang*/ rjes thob la zag bcas su 'jog ces na/ 'o na nyan thos kyi bsgom lam mnyam gzhag yin na/ zag med yin pas khyab par thal/ theg chen bsgom lam mnyam gzhag yin na zag med yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi nyan thos kyi bsgom lam mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden pa'i rnam pa can gyi bsgom lam yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi bsgom lam zag med yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de chos can/ zag bcas bsgom lam yin par thal/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ dar ṭīka pa'i phyogs la/ byang sems kyi bsgom lam mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ zag bcas yin par thal/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa gang zhig de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma grub mthar khas blangs/ snga ma der thal/ lam shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon mongs pa shin tu ma spangs pa'i phyir/ zag pa dang bcas pa kho na yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir zag bcas zag med kyi don la/ dar ṭīka pa/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtogs pa dang bcas pa dang ma bcas pa la byed do// zer/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas par thal/

zag bcas bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas blangs/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ der thal/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub par thal/ rig gter las/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mngon sum dang*// slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu// zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas par thal/ zag bcas bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ sa brgyad par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyun chad pa srid pa'am/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba gang rung du thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de gnyis gang rung min par thal/ dag pa par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mi ldan pa'i skabs mi srid pa gang zhig rtog pa dang rtog med kyi shes pa mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ dag pa par lam gyi dngos po'i rgyun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dngos po ldan dang zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ yang theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom lam dang*/ bsngo ba bsgom lam dang*/ yi rang bsgom lam gsum ka chos can/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas par thal/ zag bcas bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de dang mtshungs par ldan par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin par thal/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de min par thal/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos nyid la rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ der thal chos nyid la bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/

der thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sa gnyis pa'i mos pa bsgom lam chos can/ rtog pa yin par thal/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ de chos can/ lam shes min par thal/ lam rtog blo la ma 'khrul pa'i tshul gyi shes pa'i blo min pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad las/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib kyi rtog pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs dang*/ de dang bral ba'i rjes la mngon rtogs de/ gnyis po'i khyad par bzhed/ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib kyi rtogs pa dang bcas par thal/ zag bcas bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes sgrib gzung rtog dang bcas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod kyi shes sgrib gzung rtog ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas de spangs pa gang zhig khyod kyis rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i spangs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa med de/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib phra mo ni dbang du byas so zhe na/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes chos can/ zag bcas bsgom lam yin par thal/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib phra mo dang bcas pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i slob pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub te/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag la chos can kun rdzob pa'i snang ba yod pa'i phyir/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// zhes par/ theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam gang zhig yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zer na/ rnam bshad pa'i phyogs la nang 'gal te/ sa brgyad pa'i mos pa bsgom lam chos can/

mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog par thal/ zhen blo de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ dag pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa grub mthar khas blangs so// gzhan yang*/ rang gi grogs theg chen gyi bsgom lam dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo de/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin par thal/ zhen blo de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs te/ theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang yul gsal bar snang bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sa brgyad pa'i mos pa bsgom lam de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo mtshungs ldan dang bcas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod na/ rang don mos pa bsgom lam du thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam gang zhig yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dag pa par rang don mos pa med par thal/ de nyon yid gnas gyur pa'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ 'grel chen las/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba phra mo ma spangs pa nyid kyis rang gi don gyi mos pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'di yang rnam bshad pas khas len dgos so// sa mtshams la/ rang don mos pa sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis don mos pa sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa/ gzhan don mos pa sa bcu pa na yod do zhes zer/ mos pa gsum gyi sa mtshams de ltar mi 'thad par thal/ theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor sogs na mos pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de na 'bras yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i zhen blo yod pa'i phyir/

der thal/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam na/ lung rigs la brten nas 'bras yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su thos bsam gyis gtan la phebs pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen gyi lung drangs nas/ mos pa gsum gyi sa mtshams ji skad bshad pa de ltar byed pa mi 'thad de/ dag pa pa na/ rang don mos pa yod par thal/ de na yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ dag pa nas/ yum sher phyin rang don don dam pa chos kyi sku'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'di'i skabs kyi rang don de rang don yid byed kyi blo la byed rigs par thal/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba phra mo yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang don mos pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi rigs par thal/ mos pa gsum bsgom pa'i dus su 'di'i don gsum mngon du mi byed par bshad pa'i phyir/ der thal/ don gsal las/ bsgom pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas pa las dang por mngon du mi byed pa'i ngo bo yang rnam pa gsum mo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang mos pas bsags pa'i dge rtsa don gsum gyi rgyur bsngo ba de mi 'thad par thal/ rang don de rang don yid byed kyi blo la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ des na rang don yid byed kyi blo med na/ rang don chos sku la don gnyer gyi blo mi 'byung ngo zhe na/ 'o na/ rang don yid byed kyi blo med na/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed mi 'byung bar thal/ de med na chos sku la don gnyer gyi blo mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni// zhes par/ mos pa bsgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mos pa bsgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed cher yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ des de 'dra'i de spro ba bskyed mi nus par thal/ 'di rang gzhan gyi bstod bkur bsngags gsum de brjod pa sgra'i bdag nyid ma yin pa gang zhig gi

de bzhin gshegs pa thugs dgyes pa mos pa/ bsgom pa'i byang sems kyis rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra de rtogs yes chos sku'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma der thal/ 'di dag ni don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid can yin gyi bcam bu'i ngo bo ni ma yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir mos pa dang po bsgom pa la yon tan brjod pa chung ngur mdzad/ mos pa gsum pa bsgom pa la yon tan brjod pa chen por mdzad do zhe na/ sher phyin rang don chos sku'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa la yon tan brjod pa chung ngur mdzad pa dang*/ sher phyin gzugs sku'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa la yon tan brjod pa chen por mdzad min par yod par thal/ sher phyin chos sku'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa de chos sku'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi kun rdzob pa'i sku la dmigs pa'i dad pa las/ don dam pa'i sku la dmigs pa'i dad pa de khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ 'dir theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom pa las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/ 'dir rang gzhan mos pa'i phan yon gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ rjes thob tu sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa sngon du btang nas/ mnyam gzhag tu sher phyin bsgom pa'i byang sems kyi bsgom lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'di rang gzhan mos pa'i phan yon ma yin par thal/ mos pa dngos yin te/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can de'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ don gsal las/ ji ltar mos pa bzhin mthong ba'i chos kyi mtshan nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa zhes/

mos pa yid la byed pa sngon du song ba'i bsgom lam la mos pa bsgom lam du bshad pa'i phyir/ mos pa bsgoms pa las byung ba'i zer na/ sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa la de bzhin gshegs pas bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ 'di rang gzhan mos pa'i phan yon yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mos pa bsgoms pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la de bzhin gshegs pas bstod bkur bsngags pa mdzad pa'i yon tan gyi cha yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ khyod la de ltar mdzad pa de rang rgyu mos pa bsgom lam bsgoms pa las byung ba ma yin par thal/ khyod mos pa bsgom lam gyi rtogs pa sngon song yin pa'i phyir/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// zhes pa'i skabs su/ dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ de 'dra'i 'dun pa de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig de chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ smon lam yin par thal/ bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems byung yin par thal/ smon lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ bstan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni// sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ zhes mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i rtag der thal/ de dang mtshungs dang ldan du byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi bsngo ba de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyis dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur zin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig theg chen gyi bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyis dge rtsa khong khros 'joms nus pa gcig mi srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/

yang*/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi bsngo ba de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ min par thal/ rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa min pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud la rdzogs byang du bsgyur rgyu'i dge ba med pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi dge ba yin na/ rdzogs byang du bsgyur zin pa khyab pa'i phyir/ yang rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa de/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos bsgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi rang gzhan dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar byed pa'i bsngo ba de chos can/ theg chen gyi bsngo bar thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod yod pa gang zhig khyod yod na khyod de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dngos ma grub na shes bya chos can/ de yod par thal/ nyan thos bsgom lam pas gdul bya gzhan la theg chen gyi lam ston pa yod pa'i phyir/ yang 'khor sum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi zin pa'i sgo nas dus gsum gyi dge rtsa ma lus pa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa zhes zer na/ byang sems gnyis pa ba'i rgyud kyi theg chen gyi bsngo ba de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ 'das pa'i dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bsngo mi nus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khong khros bcom zin pa'i dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo mi nus pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs pa'i dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo mi nus par thal/ de ring bsngo bas sang nyin gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur mi nus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bsngo ba'i dus su bsngo rgyu'i rdzas med par rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ma yin pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag rdzogs byang du bsgyur dgos par thal/ bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma 'ongs pa na thob byar gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen de rdzogs byang du bsgyur dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i thob byar gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen de chos can/ khyod bsngo bas rdzogs byang du bsgyur mi dgos par thal/ khyod rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin pa'i phyir/ yang 'das pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag rdzogs byang du bsgyur dgos par thal/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shākya thub pa'i thugs rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur dgos par thal lo// gzhan yang*/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba yin na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsngo ba yin dgos par thal/ de yin na 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi zin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod par thal/ gsum la chags pas stong ste 'jig rten 'das// zhes 'jug pa las gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bsngo ba'i dge rtsa la/ chos nyid bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa yin no zer na/ chos nyid chos can/ khyod rdzogs byang du bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa min par thal/ bsngo bas bsgyur du mi rung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ 'gyur med yin pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ chos nyid chos can/ dge ba yin par thal/ don dam pa'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ kun gzhi'i sa bon chos can/ dge ba yin par thal/ rjes su 'brel ba'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na snga ma'ang ma grub bo// kho na re/ de der thal/ mngon pa las de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'o na/ de der thal/ mngon pa kun las btus las de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kun gzhi'i sa bon gyi cha dge ba yod par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ med par thal/ kun gzhi'i sa bon dang rnam smin gyi cha gnyis ka lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sum cu las/

de ni ma sgribs lung ma bstan// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ mi dge ba'i sa bon de mi dge ba yin par thal/ kun gzhi'i sa bon gyi cha mi dge ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khams gong ma na mi dge ba yod par thal/ mi dge ba'i sa bon mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ chos nyid de chos can/ rang 'bras yid 'ong 'byin byed yin par thal/ dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu med par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ bum pa'i chos nyid de rdzogs byang du bsngo rgyu'i dge bar thal/ chos nyid de bsngo rgyu'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can rdzogs byang du 'gyur du rung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid kyi skur 'gyur rung yin par thal/ de gang zhig de yin na de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa de sangs rgyas kyi chos can gyi skur 'gyur rung yin par thal/ bum pa'i chos nyid de sangs rgyas kyis chos nyid kyi skur 'gyur rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir 'du byas kyi dge ba yin na/ rdzogs byang du bsngo rgyu'i dge ba yin pas khyab par 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod bsngo bas rdzogs byang du bsgyur mi dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo'o// zer na/ shes bya chos can/ gang zag gzhan gyis gang zag gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo nus par thal/ gzhan rgyud kyi dge rtsa mtha' dag bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rdzogs byang du ma bsngos pa'i dge rtsa mi srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod na/ khong khros 'joms mi nus pa'i dge rtsa gcig mi srid par thal lo// de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// ces pa'i skabs su/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid la/

theg chen gyi bsgom lam gang zhig mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam zer na/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi mthong spangs spangs pa'i rnam grol lam de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ sgrub pa bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam mnyam gzhag gang zhig rnam gzhag bsgom lam min pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi bsgom lam bar chad med lam mngon du ma song ba'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ chos can ma grub bo zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ de 'dra yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la mthong spangs spangs pa'i so sor rgyu 'gog pa yod pa'i phyir/ yang de yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la mthong spangs kyi sa bon dang bral tsam gyi ye shes kyi cha yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin na/ bar chad med lam yin dgos par thal/ de 'dra med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi lam yin na/ rang gi ngos skal gyi shes sgrib kyi sa bon spong ba'i bar chad med lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtog pa'i mkhyen pa de chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod nyan thos kyi rtog rigs par min par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa med na/ nyan thos kyi rtog rigs mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam yod par thal/ de khyab pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa/ theg chen zag med bsgom lam gang zhig rtog pa mthar thug gi lag rjes gtso bor 'jog byed de/ sgrub pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ rnam gzhag bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam chos can/ rnam gzhag bsgom lam yin par thal/

mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spangs bya'i sa bon drungs 'byin byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rnam grol lam min pa'i phyir/ khyab par thal/ rnam gzhag bsgom lam yin na/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu yin dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu gang yin pa de zhes pa'i gzhung*/ de rnam gzhag bsgom lam ngos 'dzin pa'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa bsgom lam dang*/ rnam gzhag bsgom lam gnyis yin khyab mnyam yin par thal/ mtshan nyid gnyis po yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dag pa gzhag la sogs/ zhes sogs la/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam chos can/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na/ khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs kyang rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa yin te/ khyod des dag pa'i dag pa de dang*/ khyod kyi yul sogs gzugs sogs des dag pa'i dag pa gnyis po rang mtshan la rdzas mi dad cing*/ spyi mtshan la lhag pa so sor dpyad rgyu med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gang zag gi bdag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod des dag dag pa'i dag pa dang*/ khyod kyi yul gzugs des dag pa'i dag pa gnyis ka med pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ min par thal/ med pa'i phyir/ don ltar na rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul gzugs sogs de rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu bar chad med lam gyis ngos skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag par thal/ rnam mkhyen de des rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul gzugs sogs chos can/ dri mas rnam par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad dri mas dag par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/

dar ṭīka pa/ byang sems mthong lam pas/ bum pa bden stong du mngon sum du rtog pa'i tshe/ yul bum pa de yang*/ bum pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i dri mas dag pa yin te/ de'i tshe bum pa des/ byang sems kyi mthong lam de la/ bden med kyi rnam pa gtod byed kyi bden grub kyi rnam pa mi gtod pa'i phyir/ zer ro// 'o na/ sems can bden med du rtog pa'i rnam mkhyen de/ sems can la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi dag pa na/ yul sems can yang des dag par thal/ yul sems can de rnam mkhyen la bden med kyi rnam pa gtod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ sems can de des dag par thal/ rnam mkhyen de des dag pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rkang gsum la khas blangs/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// zhes par/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam gzhag de nyan thos kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ nyan thos sgrib dang shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam gzhag de/ rang rgyal kyi rnam gzhag gi mtshan nyid/ lam gsum gyi ci ma log par shes pa'i gegs byed kyi sgrib pa gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam gzhag de/ byang sems kyi rnam gzhag gi mtshan nyid yin zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor rtog 'gog chos can/ nyan thos kyi rnam gzhag yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod nyon sgrib tsam spangs pa'i cha nas/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor rtag 'gog du bshad pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod shes sgrib spangs pa'i cha nas nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor rtag 'gog du bzhag pa yin par thal/ gang rung gang zhig phyi ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor rtag 'gog de/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i cha nas/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog bden du bzhag par thal/ 'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i 'gog bden de la/

nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog bden du 'jog byed gcig med par thal lo// gzhan yang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i so sor rtag 'gog chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ rang rgyal gyi rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang*// rnam byang gzung rtog spangs par thal// 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi bar chad med lam rang rgyud la skye myong bar thal lo// rnam gzhag shin tu ba chos can/ byang sems kyi rnam gzhag yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de tshang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba ni rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// zhes par/ khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i bsgom lam dgu dang*/ sa dgu la brten pa'i rtog pa dgu spangs gnyen du sbyor/ zer na/ khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i bsgom lam yod par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ srid rtse'i sems la brten pa'i bsgom lam yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zag med dgu'i grangs des mi 'thad par 'gyur ro// 'dir byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas so zer na/ 'o na/ byang sems 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud la/ sgom lam dang 'dod sems kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal ba dang de'i rgyud la sgom lam dang srid rtse'i sems kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'dod pa dang srid rtse'i sems la brten pa'i sgom lam yod par thal/ 'dod na/ mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i sems dang*/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ 'dod sems dang sgom lam gyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ 'grel pa 'dir 'dod sems la mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i sems su bshad pa de mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod sems dang sgom lam mnyam gzhag gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs par thal/ 'dod sems dang sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/

shes bya chos can/ byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na byang sems kyi bsgom lam mnyam gzhag dang*/ zas kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ de'i dbang du byas na/ 'dod sems dang sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs/ srid rtse'i sems kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam de chos can/ khyod zag pa dang bcas pa'i sgom lam du thal/ rang gi sems brten zag med sa dgu gang rung lam brten pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi srid rtse la chags bral byed mi nus par thal/ khyod zas sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu de sgom spangs chen po'i chen po'i sa bon gyi spong gnyen dang*/ chen po'i chen po de sgom spangs chung ngu'i chung ngu'i spong gnyen yin no// zer na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bcu drug pa'i dngos 'bras su gyur pa'i rjes thob ye shes de/ sgom spangs chen po'i chen po de'i spong gnyen du thal/ de 'dra de theg chen gyi sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu gang zhig dam bca'i snga ma de'i phyir/ snga ma der thal/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam skad cig dang po yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ spong gnyen ma yin par thal/ rjes thob ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ yang rgyun mtha'i rnam grol lam de spong gnyen du thal/ theg chen sgom lam chen po'i chen po de spong gnyen yin pa'i phyir/ rtags/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod spong gnyen ma yin par thal/ khyod rnam grol lam yin pa'i phyir/ de na rnam grol lam yod pa ma grub bo// zhe na/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems chos can/ khyod kyi thugs rgyud kyi mthong spangs dang bral gyi ye shes kyi de rnam grol lam yin par thal/ khyod kyi thugs rgyud kyi mthong spangs dang bral gyi cha de de bzhin nyid so sor rtags 'gog yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/

khyod mthong spangs ma lus par spangs pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir ro// rlabs phreng lbu ba'i chal chil gyis// rgya mtsho mdzes par bgyid mi nus// gdengs can yid bzhin rin chen gyis// mtsho chen khyad par 'phags de bzhin// tshig 'phreng lbu ba'i mdo shal gyis// mkhas pa'i grangs su bgrang mi nus// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nor gyis ni// mkhas pa'i khyad par bgrang bar nus// shes thal ngag dbang po'i rdo rje las skabs pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// mang du gsan cing de don rig pa yis// rnam par dpyad nas blo gsal mang po'i phyir// rtag tu lags med yi ger bkod brtson pa'i// yang dag dge ba'i bshes gyis mgon mdzod cig /tshur rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes par/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes chos can/ 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas te/ 'khor ba rang bzhin med par rtog par thal/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas te/ snying rjes gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/ zer na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las chos can/ der thal/ 'khor ba rang bzhin med par rtog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gang zhig 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ 'khor ba'i mtha' la gnas par thal/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'khor ba'i rgyud la gnas pa'i phyir/ rtags grub par thal/ sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun chad pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par thal/ 'khor ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gnas par thal/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyis bar du mig bag chags kyi sa'i dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba bzhes pa'i phyir/ rtags grub par thal/ byang sems 'phags pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ lhag med myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par thal/ snying rjes gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/

khyod theg chen lam du zhugs nas snying rjes gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ der thal/ chad pa'i myang 'das la gnas gzhan pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ lha de nyid myang 'das mngon du byed par nges pa'i sku tshe'i 'du byed ma btang ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ snying rjes gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snying rje'i dbang gis rang bzhin gdul bya la chos ston pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na/ nyan thos 'phags pa la snying rje tshad med par 'dod dgos so// rtsa bar 'dod na/ der thal/ theg dman gyi lhag med kyi myang 'das kyi mtha' la gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yang ma grub na/ de'i rgyud nyid gzhi shes chos can/ srid zhi grub cing mtha' la gnas par thal/ theg dman gyi 'das yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khas blangs shing*/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzhi shes chos can/ 'khor ba'i mtha' la gnas par thal/ srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la gnas pa gang zhig zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes gang zhig srid zhi rang bzhin med par rtog pa de srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ de gang zhig 'khor 'das la blang dor du mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bcas pa de/ srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ srid zhi rang bzhin med par rtogs par thal/ srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhi shes gang zhig srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ srid pa'i mtha' med pa gang zhig zhi ba'i mtha' med pa'i phyir/ dam tshig gcig shos la'ang skyon de 'phags pa chos can/ mtshon bya la srid zhi la gnas pa dang mi gnas pa zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhi shes gang zhig

de la mi gnas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ srid zhi la gnas pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khor ba la gnas na myang 'das la gnas par 'gal ba'i phyir/ yang srid zhi gang rung la gnas pa dang mi gnas pa zer na/ srid zhi gang rung la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes med par thal/ gzhi shes yin na/ srid zhi gang rung la gnas dgos pa'i phyir/ de dgos par thal/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes yin na'ang de yin/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes yin na'ang de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma khas blangs/ snga ma der thal/ theg chen slob pa'i gzhi shes yin na srid pa la gnas dgos/ theg chen gyi mi slob pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ zhi ba la gnas dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa 'bud/ dang po der thal/ de yin na/ sems can gyi shes rgyud la 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags 'bud/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i gzhi shes chos can/ srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin par thal/ 'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs shing*/ der thal/ gzhi shes gang zhig der 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin lhan skyes dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ shes bya thams cad la bder 'dzin pa'i bder 'dzin lhan skyes dang bcas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mthong lam pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas ces par/ nyang gi gzhi shes 'bras yum la ring*/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes la nye zer na/ nyan thos kyi gzhi shes chos can/ 'bras yum la nye bar thal/ rnam mkhyen la nye ba'i phyir/ der thal/ lam zhugs mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa med par thal/ theg pa gsum gyi nges byung thal/ theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes pa'i lung don grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ nyan thos dgra bcom theg chen gyi lam du zhugs ma thag pa'i gzhi shes gnyis/

'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par med par thal/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes yin na/ 'bras yum la nye bas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod dang de gnyis la 'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par med par thal/ khyod dang de gnyis ka 'bras yum gyi sar bgrod pa la/ tshogs lam skad cig dang po nas/ rgyun mtha'i bar gyi lam dgrod dgos par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos can dang gcig gang zhig gcig shos de theg chen gyi tshogs lam skad cig po la gnas gzhan pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ nyan thos dgra bcom theg chen lam du zhugs pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa'i rgyu nyid gzhi shes de nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzhi shes la ltos ste/ khyod 'bras yum la nye bar thal/ khyod byang sems kyis gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzhi shes de chos can/ khyod snga ma de la ltos te/ 'bras bu la nye bar thal/ khyod nyan thos pa'i ma lus par spangs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ yang theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma gang zhig khyod der zhugs ma thag tu snga ma 'bras yum la nye ba'i phyir/ ma grub na/ nyan thos dgra bcom theg chen lam du zhugs ma thag pa de chos can/ khyod nyan thos mthong lam pa theg chen lam du zhugs pa de las/ 'bras yum la nye bar thal/ khyod nyan thos pa'i ma lus par spangs pa'i theg chen gyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang zhes par/ nyan thos kyi gzhi shes chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i phyir zhe na/ de chos can/ mtshan 'dzin dang mtshungs ldan yin par thal/ de dang bcas pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtogs par thal/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes min par thal/ mi mthun phyogs gi gzhi shes mi srid pa'i phyir/

der thal/ gzhi shes yin na/ gnyen po yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ gzhi lam rang bzhin med par rtog pa'i gzhi shes yin par thal/ gnyen po gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bar chad med lam du gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar khas blangs so// gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyis mtshan nyid zer na/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes de chos can/ dam tshigs der thal/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ de der thal/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid la/ spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs gzhi shes med pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ gzugs sogs la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin pa dang bcas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ min par thal/ gzugs sogs stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems sa gnyis pa'i sgom rjes thob ye shes chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes su thal/ dam tshigs med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhi shes gang zhig de dang bcas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin lhan skyes dang bcas pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma dag pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir mtshan nyid dang bcas pa'i don de gang la byed 'dri'o// de dang mtshungs par ldan pa la byed zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ de dang mtshungs par ldan par thal/ de dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum par khas blangs so// 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang gi grogs sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang mtshungs ldan min par thal/ rtog med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de dang 'dzin spangs mi 'gal ba la byed zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa min par thal/

de dang 'dzin spangs thal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod dang de'i 'dzin spangs phan tshun tha dad/ de gnyis kyi zhi mthun mi srid pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ khyod 'dzin spangs yin na/ de'i 'dzin spangs yin par thal ba'i phyir/ rtags 'bud do// yang de chos can/ khyod kyi 'dzin spangs dang*/ de'i 'dzin spangs bsal bar thal/ khyod dgag pa'i rnam pa can gang zhig de sgrub pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang*/ mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i don bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa la byed do ce na/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi rtog pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ de gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin dang bcas par thal/ bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin par thal/ gzhi lam/ 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ gsum par khas blangs so// yang*/ bdag med ma rtogs pa la byed zhe na/ 'o na/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba'i don/ bdag med rtogs pa la byed rigs par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ mtshan 'dzin dang bral bar thal/ bdag med rtogs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ so so skye bo'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med zhes par/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba'i gzhi shes de/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi dam tshig zer na/ gang zhig bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam gyi ma nges pas/ snga ma ltar 'phags pa chos can/ der ma zad nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ ma rdzogs der thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ der thal/ gzhi shes gang zhig de dang bral ba'i phyir/ der thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i phyir/
